  "decision-audit-independent-glaze-attributions": "WITH families AS (
  SELECT specimen_code, family_code, min(glaze_name) AS glaze_name,
         min(slip_id COLLATE BINARY) AS slip_id
  FROM glaze_slip
  GROUP BY specimen_code, family_code
  HAVING count(DISTINCT glaze_name) = 1
), totals AS (
  SELECT specimen_code, glaze_name, count(*) AS vote_count
  FROM families
  GROUP BY specimen_code, glaze_name
), ranked AS (
  SELECT totals.*, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY specimen_code ORDER BY vote_count DESC) AS place,
         count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY specimen_code, vote_count) AS tied_count
  FROM totals
)

JOIN families AS f USING (specimen_code, glaze_name)

  JOIN route_notes AS n ON n.route_code = b.route_code
    AND b.pickup_day BETWEEN n.first_day AND n.last_day
